# Step - limit

`limit` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Passes on only the first n traversers; with Scope.local the first n elements of each collection.

## Forms

```text
limit(arg1: i64)
limit(arg1: Scope, arg2: i64)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("name").limit(2).to_list()   // ["marko", "vadas"]
```
